$comment: The ONLY way audio enters public/assets/audio (D31). Edit this file, run `node scripts/audio/build-audio.mjs`, commit the outputs. Every source needs a licence from allowedLicenses; CC-BY-* also needs a shipped credit (credits.json). Kinds set loudness: oneshot -18, bed -26, ui -24, note -20 LUFS (music instrument samples, b3.5g: one key per sampled pitch, music.<instrument>.<sounding note, s = sharp>, pitch measured, not taken from the source file name) (+-1 LU). Tiers: boot <= 1.5 MB, match <= 3.5 MB, music <= 1.0 MB (reserved for b3.5g), zones <= 2.0 MB, total <= 8 MB. frequent:true keys need >= 3 variants. Variants: src + member (archive path) | start/dur (s) | split (index of the n-th non-silent segment) | semitones (derived pitch variant) ; beds are cut as seamless loops of loopLen s with a crossfade of xfade s.
